claims.claim_ar: الجذر: أ-م-ن؛ دالّ على الإيمان/التصديق والأمان. في السياق القرآني غالبًا معنى الإيمان أي التصديق بالله أو رسله.
claims.claim_en: Root: أ‑م‑ن (ʾ‑m‑n) meaning 'to believe; to have faith; to be secure.' In Qur'anic usage this root most often denotes 'to believe' (to have faith in God).

claims.claim_ar: الفعل من باب أول (فعل) ثلاثي مجرد: الآمرة/الماضي آمنَ / آمَنَ، وصيغته في المضارع الجمع يظهر كـ يُؤْمِنُونَ (مضارع الغائب للمثنى/الجمع ببادئة ياء وواو الجماعة).
claims.claim_en: Pattern: triliteral Form I (the basic/ground verb). Base past is آمنَ/آمَنَ; the present plural form appears as يُؤْمِنُونَ — the third-person masculine plural imperfect of a Form I verb.

warnings: Source chunks provided contain an exact attestation for the past plural form 'آمَنُوا' (used above) but do not contain the exact ayah form 'يُؤْمِنُونَ' as a substring. The claims above use the attested substring as supporting evidence for the same root/pattern.

Many words in the ayah (e.g., يُحَكِّمُوكَ, قَضَيْتَ, تُسَلِّمُوا) do not have matching exact substrings in the provided source_chunks; no independent source_quote_ar could be supplied for claims about those words. Claims are therefore limited to items for which a supporting substring was present.
